description: Recent contract event logs on Sonic (eth_getLogs): the events a contract emitted over the last N blocks (1-1,000, default 50), optionally filtered by topic0 (the 0x 32-byte event signature hash). Returns up to 100 logs with block, transaction hash and topics. Use to watch transfers or contract events; for one transaction's outcome use sonic_receipt. Example: address=0x29219dd400f2Bf60E5a23d13Be72B486D4038894. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks to scan (1-1000, default 50)

topic0.description: Optional 0x event signature hash to filter by

name: sonic_logs
title: Sonic recent event logs
